absolute-advantage.def: The ability to produce more of a good than another producer with the same resources, or the same amount with fewer resources.

comparative-advantage.def: The ability to produce a good at a lower opportunity cost than another producer.

specialization.def: Concentrating production on the goods a producer makes at the lowest opportunity cost, and trading for the rest.

terms-of-trade.def: The rate at which one good is exchanged for another; trade benefits both sides when the terms lie between their opportunity costs, and those benefits are the gains from trade.
